zh: 美股週一全面收低：道瓊跌 0.29% 收 52,421 點，標普 500 跌 0.48% 收 7,619.98 點，那斯達克跌 0.56% 收 26,186 點，但都收在盤中低點之上。主因是 Anthropic 執行長 Amodei 週末發表長文，主張放慢前沿 AI 模型的開發速度，OpenAI 的 Altman 與 xAI 的馬斯克隨後表態支持。市場把這讀成「AI 資本支出的成長假設多了一個政策變數」，賣壓集中在半導體、資料中心、光通訊與電力設備。同一天醫療、通訊服務與必需消費逆勢走強，資金是在科技板塊內部與防禦類股之間換位，不是全面撤出股市。
en: U.S. stocks closed lower Monday: the Dow fell 0.29% to 52,421, the S&P 500 lost 0.48% to 7,619.98 and the Nasdaq slipped 0.56% to 26,186, all well off their intraday lows. The trigger was a weekend essay by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calling for a slower pace of frontier AI development, which OpenAI's Sam Altman and xAI's Elon Musk then endorsed. Markets read it as a new policy variable in the AI capex growth story, and selling concentrated in semiconductors, data centers, optical networking and power equipment. Health care, communication services and consumer staples rose, so money rotated within tech and toward defensives rather than leaving equities.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，收跌 0.48%，收在盤中低點之上
那斯達克 100 ETF，AI 權重最高、跌幅大於大盤

zh: 被「放慢 AI」直接點到的是晶片股。盤中美光跌約 5%、超微跌約 5%、英特爾跌約 5.7%、博通跌 3.4%，輝達跌幅約 2% 到 3%，相對抗跌。記憶體與 CPU 跌得比輝達重，反映市場擔心的是「邊際需求」：若前沿模型訓練放慢，最先被砍的是擴產中的記憶體與通用伺服器訂單，而不是已經簽下的 GPU 產能。要注意的是，這篇文章提的是監督與監管框架，不是任何公司宣布減少資本支出，實際訂單要到下一季財報才看得到。
en: Chip stocks took the most direct hit from the 'slow down AI' call. Intraday, Micron fell about 5%, AMD about 5%, Intel about 5.7% and Broadcom 3.4%, while Nvidia dropped only about 2% to 3%. Memory and CPU names fell harder than Nvidia, suggesting the worry is marginal demand: if frontier training slows, expansion orders for memory and general servers would be cut before GPU capacity already under contract. Note that the essay proposed oversight and regulation frameworks; no company announced lower capex, and actual orders will only show up in next quarter's reports.

stocks.n: 半導體 ETF，AI 放慢論的第一線受壓指標
美光，盤中跌約 5%，記憶體擴產需求被質疑
英特爾，盤中跌約 5.7%，跌幅大於輝達

zh: 沙烏地東西向管線停擺的效應延續，布蘭特原油週一盤中一度升到 108 美元，收盤漲 1.07% 至 105.68 美元，西德州原油漲 1.34% 至 101.39 美元。這條管線每天輸送約 400 萬到 500 萬桶，占波斯灣原油出口的三到四成，延布港的存油只夠撐五到七天。比較反直覺的是黃金：地緣風險升溫，金價卻跌 1.29% 至每盎司 4,351.90 美元。原因是 10 年期公債殖利率一度升破 5%，市場押週三升息，持有不生息資產的機會成本變高，利率壓過了避險需求。
en: The shutdown of Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline kept pushing oil higher. Brent briefly reached $108 on Monday and settled up 1.07% at $105.68, while WTI rose 1.34% to $101.39. The line carries about 4 million to 5 million barrels a day, 30% to 40% of Gulf crude exports, and Yanbu has only five to seven days of stored supply. Gold did the counterintuitive thing: despite rising geopolitical risk, it fell 1.29% to $4,351.90 an ounce. The 10-year Treasury yield briefly topped 5% and markets are betting on a Wednesday hike, raising the opportunity cost of holding a non-yielding asset, so rates outweighed safe-haven demand.

stocks.n: 布蘭特原油 ETF，收漲 1.07%、盤中一度 108 美元
黃金 ETF，金價逆勢跌 1.29%，利率壓過避險需求

zh: 同一天兩則評級調整方向完全相反。摩根士丹利把 Stellantis 從中立降到減碼，目標價由 8 美元砍到 5.2 美元，理由是庫存與促銷變化、新車款進度落後同業，現金產生能力下滑時很難再縮減投資，股價跌逾 2%。另一邊，摩根大通把 IREN 從減碼連升兩級到加碼，目標價由 46 美元上調到 65 美元，認為它已站穩一線新雲端算力業者、有輝達的策略合作撐腰。在大家都在賣 AI 基礎建設的一天，分析師反而升評一檔算力股，說明賣方看的是個別公司簽約進度，不是一篇文章。
en: Two rating changes went in opposite directions on the same day. Morgan Stanley cut Stellantis to underweight from equal weight and slashed its target to $5.20 from $8, citing inventory and incentive trends and a product pipeline lagging peers that limits its ability to cut investment as cash generation declines; the stock fell more than 2%. Meanwhile, JPMorgan double-upgraded IREN to overweight from underweight and raised its target to $65 from $46, saying it is becoming a top-tier neocloud backed by a strategic partnership with Nvidia. On a day when AI infrastructure was being sold, an analyst upgraded a compute name, a sign the sell side is tracking contract momentum, not one essay.

stocks.n: Stellantis，大摩降至減碼、目標價 5.2 美元，股價跌逾 2%
IREN，摩根大通連升兩級至加碼、目標價 65 美元

zh: 娛樂餐飲連鎖 Dave & Buster's 週一盤後公布第二季：營收 5.441 億美元、年減 2.4%，低於市場預估的 5.613 億美元；同店銷售年減 2.9%；調整後每股虧損 0.27 美元，市場原本預期每股賺 0.19 美元；調整後 EBITDA 9,890 萬美元、年減 24%。管理層強調 7 月同店銷售改善、第三季至今持續好轉，上半年調整後自由現金流轉為正 1,950 萬美元，但長期負債仍有 15 億美元。股價今年已跌約 48%，財報後盤後一度再跌 13%，市場顯然不打算先相信「回歸基本面策略奏效」這個說法。
en: Dave & Buster's reported second-quarter results after Monday's close: revenue fell 2.4% to $544.1 million, below the $561.3 million estimate; comparable store sales dropped 2.9%; the adjusted loss was 27 cents a share versus expectations for a 19-cent profit; adjusted EBITDA fell 24% to $98.9 million. Management highlighted improving same-store sales in July and continued gains so far in the third quarter, and first-half adjusted free cash flow turned positive at $19.5 million, but long-term debt is still about $1.5 billion. The stock was already down about 48% this year and fell as much as 13% after hours, so the market is not ready to take the 'back-to-basics' story on faith.

stocks.n: Dave & Buster's，Q2 虧損遠差於預期，盤後一度跌 13%
非必需消費 ETF，娛樂型外食是可選消費最先被砍的一塊

zh: 金融時報報導，GE HealthCare 正洽談以約 10 億美元收購 Sofie Biosciences，最快下週宣布。Sofie 總部在維吉尼亞州，成立約 20 年，做的是癌症 PET 掃描用的放射性造影劑。GE HealthCare 的強項是掃描機器，旗下「藥物診斷」部門則供應掃描時注射的藥劑；買下 Sofie 等於把機器與耗材綁得更緊，耗材是每做一次檢查就收一次錢的經常性營收。這筆規模對 GE HealthCare 不大，但方向清楚：放射性藥物正從治療端延伸到診斷端，專做 PET 造影劑的同業會被拿來重新比價。
en: GE HealthCare is in talks to buy Sofie Biosciences for about $1 billion, the Financial Times reported, with a deal possible as soon as next week. Sofie, a Virginia-based company about 20 years old, makes radioactive agents used in cancer PET scans. GE HealthCare's strength is scanners, while its pharmaceutical diagnostics unit supplies the agents injected during scans; buying Sofie ties machines and consumables more tightly, and consumables bring recurring revenue with every exam. The deal is small for GE HealthCare, but the direction is clear: radiopharmaceuticals are extending from therapy into diagnostics, and pure-play PET agent makers will be re-benchmarked.

stocks.n: GE HealthCare，洽談約 10 億美元收購 PET 造影劑廠 Sofie
Lantheus，PET 造影劑龍頭，同業併購會被拿來重新比價

zh: 首爾舉行的世界肺癌大會上，兩家藥廠的臨床數據帶動股價。GSK 公布兩組肺癌治療的正面結果，一是 zidesamtinib（品牌名 Jideytro），另一個是從中國翰森製藥授權引進的 Ris-Rez，美國存託憑證週一漲 3.83% 收 49.97 美元。BioNTech 也因肺癌試驗數據漲約 6.4%。這兩則消息是醫療類股週一成為最強板塊的原因之一，也跟前兩週醫療類股連續墊底形成對比。GSK 引進中國藥廠授權分子的成功，也是跨國藥廠向中國生技買新藥這條路線的又一個驗證。
en: At the World Conference on Lung Cancer in Seoul, trial data lifted two drugmakers. GSK presented positive results for two lung cancer treatments, zidesamtinib (branded Jideytro) and Ris-Rez, licensed from China's Hansoh Pharmaceutical, and its ADRs rose 3.83% to $49.97 on Monday. BioNTech gained about 6.4% on its own lung cancer data. The news helped make health care Monday's strongest sector, a contrast with the group finishing last for the previous two weeks. GSK's success with a molecule licensed from a Chinese drugmaker is another validation of global pharma buying new drugs from Chinese biotech.

stocks.n: GSK，兩組肺癌數據正面，美股收漲 3.83%
BioNTech，肺癌試驗數據帶動股價漲約 6.4%

zh: 聯準會今明兩天開會，台灣時間週四凌晨 2 點公布決議。CME FedWatch 顯示期貨交易員押升息一碼、利率區間升到 3.75% 至 4.00% 的機率約九成，高盛與摩根大通的預測也站在同一邊；若成真，這是 2023 年以來首次升息。因為升息幾乎已被定價，市場真正要看的是兩件事：點陣圖是否暗示年底前還要再升，以及主席華許在記者會上怎麼描述油價造成的通膨。截至上週五，期貨定價的政策利率是 12 月約 4.1%、明年 9 月約 4.6%，等於市場已經預期這不是只升一次。
en: The Fed meets today and tomorrow, with the decision due at 2 a.m. Thursday Taiwan time. CME FedWatch shows futures traders putting roughly 90% odds on a quarter-point hike to a 3.75%-4.00% range, and Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan forecast the same; it would be the first hike since 2023. With the move largely priced in, markets will focus on two things: whether the dot plot signals another hike before year-end, and how Chair Warsh describes oil-driven inflation at his press conference. As of last Friday, futures priced the policy rate at about 4.1% by December and 4.6% by September 2027, meaning markets already expect more than one hike.

stocks.n: 1-3 年期公債 ETF，對升息路徑最敏感
金融類股 ETF，升息擴大利差、但也壓抑放款需求

zh: 上週五公布的 8 月消費者物價指數，把聯準會的兩難攤在桌上。整體 CPI 月增 0.4%、年增 3.4%；但扣掉食品與能源的核心 CPI 年增 2.4%，比 7 月的 2.5% 還低，月增 0.3%。兩者差了一個百分點，差距幾乎全部來自油價與汽油。升息擋得住的是需求端的通膨，擋不住管線被炸造成的供給衝擊；但如果不動作，能源價格可能透過運輸與機票慢慢滲進核心物價。這也是為什麼週三的記者會比決議本身更重要：主席怎麼切割「能源」與「核心」，決定市場怎麼預期下一步。
en: Last Friday's August consumer price index laid out the Fed's dilemma. Headline CPI rose 0.4% on the month and 3.4% from a year earlier, but core CPI, which excludes food and energy, rose 2.4%, down from 2.5% in July, and 0.3% on the month. The one-point gap comes almost entirely from oil and gasoline. Rate hikes can curb demand-driven inflation but not a supply shock from a bombed pipeline; yet doing nothing risks energy costs seeping into core prices through freight and airfares. That is why Wednesday's press conference matters more than the decision itself: how the chair separates energy from core will shape expectations for the next move.

stocks.n: 抗通膨公債 ETF，整體通膨 3.4% 高於核心時的受惠工具
航空 ETF，能源成本滲入票價的第一條傳導路徑

zh: 美國 10 年期公債殖利率週一盤中升到 5.014%，是 2023 年以來首次突破 5%，收盤回落到約 4.95%；30 年期一度觸及 5.38%。推升的力量有兩股：布蘭特原油一度 108 美元帶來的通膨擔憂，以及政府與企業同時大量發債造成的供給壓力。5% 對股市的意義是，無風險報酬已經接近標普 500 的盈餘殖利率，股票的風險溢酬被壓得很薄。對實體經濟最直接的傳導是房貸，長端利率不降，房貸利率就很難回落，週三盤後 Lennar 的新訂單數字會是第一個讀數。
en: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield rose as high as 5.014% on Monday, topping 5% for the first time since 2023, before settling near 4.95%; the 30-year touched 5.38%. Two forces pushed it up: inflation worries as Brent briefly hit $108, and supply pressure from heavy borrowing by both the government and companies. At 5%, the risk-free return is close to the S&P 500's earnings yield, leaving a thin equity risk premium. The most direct channel into the real economy is mortgages: if long rates stay high, mortgage rates can't fall much, and Lennar's new orders after Wednesday's close will be the first read.

stocks.n: 20 年期以上公債 ETF，長端殖利率破 5% 的直接反映
住宅建商 ETF，房貸利率難降的最大受害族群

zh: 同一篇「放慢 AI」的文章，讓資安股走出完全相反的行情。週一盤中 CrowdStrike 漲約 14.9%、Zscaler 漲約 15.2%、SentinelOne 漲約 15%、Palo Alto 漲約 12.8%，Okta 漲約 4%。邏輯是 Amodei 在文中警告自主 AI 代理群可能造成數千億美元損失：AI 越強、越多代理在企業內運作，要保護的身分、端點與攻擊面就越多，資安預算只會增加。同時資安公司賣的是軟體訂閱，不必背負晶片與電力的資本支出，被市場視為「受惠 AI 風險、但不怕 AI 放慢」的少數族群。
en: The same 'slow down AI' essay sent cybersecurity stocks the opposite way. Intraday Monday, CrowdStrike rose about 14.9%, Zscaler about 15.2%, SentinelOne about 15% and Palo Alto about 12.8%, with Okta up about 4%. Amodei warned that swarms of autonomous AI agents could cause hundreds of billions of dollars in damage: the more capable AI becomes and the more agents run inside companies, the more identities, endpoints and attack surfaces need protecting. Security vendors also sell software subscriptions without chip or power capex, so markets see them as rare beneficiaries of AI risk that don't suffer if AI slows.

stocks.n: CrowdStrike，盤中漲約 14.9%，資安族群領頭
Zscaler，盤中漲約 15.2%，零信任架構受惠 AI 代理擴散
資安 ETF，一次涵蓋整個族群

zh: 今年最熱的「AI 缺電」主題週一遭到重擊。GE Vernova 收跌 8.62%，是大盤跌幅的將近 18 倍，歐洲的 Siemens Energy 也同步重挫，資料中心、光通訊與電力公用事業一起走弱。這些公司的估值建立在「資料中心用電需求連續多年高速成長」的假設上，只要 AI 開發速度出現政策上限的可能，最先被重新折價的就是離算力最遠、但估值最高的電力設備。反過來看，燃氣渦輪與電網設備的訂單多是多年期合約、交期排到數年後，短期營收不會因一篇文章改變，差別在市場願意付的倍數。
en: This year's hottest theme, AI-driven power shortages, took a heavy hit Monday. GE Vernova closed down 8.62%, nearly 18 times the market's decline, Europe's Siemens Energy also slumped, and data centers, optical networking and power utilities weakened together. These valuations rest on data center power demand growing rapidly for years, so any hint of a policy cap on AI development gets priced first into power equipment, far from compute but richly valued. On the other hand, gas turbine and grid equipment orders are multi-year contracts with lead times stretching years, so near-term revenue won't change because of one essay; what changes is the multiple investors will pay.

stocks.n: GE Vernova，收跌 8.62%，AI 電力主題的代表股
公用事業 ETF，電力需求題材一起被折價

zh: 喊放慢的同一天，算力合約還在簽。The Information 報導，Anthropic 與 RUM Group（原影音平台 Rumble 母公司）簽下六年、137 億美元的算力採購合約，使用 RUM 在喬治亞州梅斯維爾資料中心的 GPU，RUM 股價盤中漲約 18%。另一方面，OpenAI 決定今年不上市，軟銀跌 11.4%；摩根大通把比特幣礦商轉型資料中心的 MARA 連降兩級到減碼，股價跌約 2%。這組消息說明板塊內在分化：真正拿到大客戶長約的業者被追價，只有題材、沒有簽約的轉型股被降評。
en: On the same day AI leaders called for a slowdown, compute contracts were still being signed. The Information reported that Anthropic signed a six-year, $13.7 billion compute deal with RUM Group, the former parent of video platform Rumble, using GPUs at RUM's data center in Maysville, Georgia; RUM rose about 18% intraday. Meanwhile, OpenAI's decision to forgo a 2026 IPO sent SoftBank down 11.4%, and JPMorgan double-downgraded MARA, a bitcoin miner pivoting to data centers, to underweight, with shares down about 2%. The sector is splitting: operators with long contracts from major customers are being bid up, while pivot stories without signed deals are being downgraded.

stocks.n: RUM Group，拿到 Anthropic 六年 137 億美元算力合約，盤中漲約 18%
MARA，摩根大通連降兩級至減碼，轉型資料中心缺乏直接成長來源

zh: 羅素 2000 週一跌 0.40% 收 2,892 點，跌幅小於標普 500 的 0.48% 與那斯達克的 0.56%。在一個被 AI 大型股拖累的交易日，小型股相對抗跌並不意外：指數裡半導體與超大型科技股權重低，受「放慢 AI」衝擊較小。但別把它讀成資金大舉轉進小型股，羅素 2000 的年內高點停在 8/14，此後一個月沒有再創高。本週的真正考驗是週三升息：小型公司的借款比大型公司更依賴銀行貸款與浮動利率，利率每升一段，利息費用就更快吃進獲利。
en: The Russell 2000 fell 0.40% Monday to 2,892, less than the S&P 500's 0.48% and the Nasdaq's 0.56% declines. On a day dragged down by AI megacaps, small caps holding up better isn't surprising: the index has low weights in semiconductors and mega-cap tech, so the 'slow down AI' shock hit it less. But don't read it as a big rotation into small caps; the Russell 2000's high for the year was set Aug. 14 and it hasn't made a new one since. This week's real test is Wednesday's hike: smaller companies rely more on bank loans and floating-rate debt, so each step up in rates eats into profits faster.

stocks.n: 羅素 2000 ETF，收跌 0.40%，跌幅小於大型股
羅素 2000 價值股 ETF，科技權重更低、升息週的觀察對照

zh: 鎢與鉬零組件製造商 Elmet Group 週一同時拿到兩份政府支票：國防後勤局為重建國家國防儲備，給它一份上限約 20 億美元的鎢礦砂、精礦與鎢酸鈉供應合約；美國戰爭部另外承諾投資 4.5 億美元，交割時先撥 2 億美元，用於更新美國廠房與內華達州的 Springer 鎢礦園區。股價盤前一度漲近 46%，盤中漲幅收斂到約 31%。要分清楚的是：20 億美元是合約上限，保證下單的最低承諾只有 1.5 億美元；4.5 億美元的投資是股權、債務還是認股權，新聞稿沒有講清楚，可能有稀釋。背景是中國限制鎢出口、美國本土沒有運作中的鎢礦。
en: Elmet Group, a maker of tungsten and molybdenum components, landed two government checks Monday: a Defense Logistics Agency contract worth up to about $2 billion to supply tungsten ores, concentrates and sodium tungstate for the National Defense Stockpile, and a $450 million committed investment from the Department of War, with $200 million drawn at closing, to modernize U.S. plants and the Springer Tungsten Complex in Nevada. Shares jumped nearly 46% premarket before settling to about a 31% gain midday. Be clear on the terms: $2 billion is a ceiling, with a guaranteed minimum of only $150 million, and the release doesn't say whether the $450 million is equity, debt or warrants, so dilution is possible. The backdrop is Chinese tungsten export curbs and no operating U.S. tungsten mine.

zh: 小型生技 Corbus Pharmaceuticals 公布口服減重藥 CRB-913 的 1b 期 CANYON-1 試驗頂線結果：254 位非糖尿病肥胖成人、三個劑量都達統計顯著，扣除安慰劑後的減重幅度，20 毫克 2.8%、40 毫克 3.3%，60 毫克平均約 5%，而且腸胃道副作用少於已上市的口服 GLP-1。股價盤前漲 14.4% 到 9.29 美元，52 週低點是 7.12 美元。判讀時要冷靜：5% 的減重幅度遠低於注射型 GLP-1，這個分子賣的是「副作用少、可以跟其他藥合併使用」的定位；完整數據 11 月 ObesityWeek 發表，2 期單藥試驗要到 2027 年上半年才啟動。
en: Small biotech Corbus Pharmaceuticals reported topline Phase 1b CANYON-1 results for oral obesity drug CRB-913: in 254 obese adults without diabetes, all three doses hit statistical significance, with placebo-adjusted weight loss of 2.8% at 20 mg, 3.3% at 40 mg and about 5% on average at 60 mg, plus fewer gastrointestinal side effects than marketed oral GLP-1 drugs. Shares rose 14.4% premarket to $9.29, against a 52-week low of $7.12. Keep perspective: 5% weight loss is far below injectable GLP-1s, so the molecule's pitch is tolerability and use in combinations; full data come at ObesityWeek in November, and a Phase 2 monotherapy study won't start until the first half of 2027.

zh: 穿戴式心臟去顫器公司 Kestra Medical 週一盤後公布會計年度第一季：營收 3,100 萬美元、年增 60%，毛利率從 45.7% 升到 56.5%，全年營收指引從 1.37 億上修到 1.41 億美元。但調整後每股虧損 0.75 美元，比預估的 0.45 美元多了六成多，淨損擴大到 4,410 萬美元，季度營運現金流出 3,230 萬美元。股價盤前收漲 5.3% 到 24.06 美元，盤後反跌 9.43%。這是判讀成長型小型股的典型場景：營收成長已經被股價預期，市場接著看的是燒錢速度，手上 2.45 億美元現金以目前的流出速度大約撐兩年。
en: Wearable cardiac defibrillator maker Kestra Medical reported fiscal first-quarter results after Monday's close: revenue rose 60% to $31.0 million, gross margin climbed to 56.5% from 45.7%, and full-year revenue guidance rose to $141 million from $137 million. But the adjusted loss of 75 cents a share was more than 60% wider than the 45-cent estimate, the net loss widened to $44.1 million, and operating cash burn was $32.3 million. Shares closed up 5.3% at $24.06, then fell 9.43% after hours. It's a classic setup for growth small caps: revenue growth was already priced in, so the market turned to burn rate, and $245 million in cash lasts roughly two years at the current pace.

zh: 判讀小型股消息面的一個知識：盤前漲幅常常會打折。週一的兩個例子，Elmet Group 盤前一度漲近 46%，到了盤中只剩約 31%；Corbus 盤前漲 14.4%，也是在正式開盤前的報價。盤前與盤後交易的參與者少、掛單薄，幾筆市價單就能把價格推得很遠，等到正規交易時段大量賣單進場，才形成比較真實的價格。所以看到「消息股盤前大漲」時，比較可靠的讀法是等收盤價與成交量：若收盤仍守住大部分漲幅、而且量是平日的數倍，才代表有新資金認同，而不是早起的少數人在追價。
en: A lesson in reading small-cap news: premarket gains often get marked down. Two examples Monday: Elmet Group rose nearly 46% premarket but was up only about 31% midday, and Corbus's 14.4% jump was also a pre-open quote. Premarket and after-hours sessions have few participants and thin order books, so a handful of market orders can move prices far, and a more realistic price forms only when regular-session sellers arrive. When a news stock surges premarket, a more reliable read is to wait for the close and volume: if it holds most of the gain on several times normal volume, new money agrees, rather than a few early buyers chasing.

zh: Omega Flex 生產瓦斯用的不鏽鋼波紋軟管（CSST）與醫院氣體用的 MediTrac 管材，市值約 2.6 億美元。為什麼被忽視：賣方分析師追蹤極少，產品又綁在新屋開工這個正在下滑的循環上，媒體聲量幾近於零。什麼正在改變：9/14 總裁 Edwin Moran 以 25.43 美元買進 790 股、財務長 Matthew Unger 以 25.42 美元買進 1,000 股，股價貼著 52 週低點 25.58 美元（高點 37.92 美元）；8 月 MediTrac 取得歐盟 CE 認證，打開醫療市場；季配息 0.34 美元，以現價計殖利率約 5.3%，毛利率即使下滑仍有 55%。風險與反方論點：兩人合計只買約 4.5 萬美元，金額小、訊號偏弱；第二季營收年減 5.8%、營業利益年減 35.3%，升息讓新屋開工更難回溫。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Omega Flex makes corrugated stainless steel tubing for gas lines and MediTrac tubing for hospital gases, with a market value of about $260 million. Why it's ignored: almost no sell-side coverage, products tied to a declining housing-start cycle and near-zero media attention. What's changing: on Sept. 14 President Edwin Moran bought 790 shares at $25.43 and CFO Matthew Unger bought 1,000 at $25.42, with the stock sitting on its 52-week low of $25.58 (high $37.92); MediTrac won EU CE mark approval in August, opening medical markets; the $0.34 quarterly dividend yields about 5.3%, and gross margin is still 55% after slipping. Risks and counterpoints: the two bought only about $45,000 combined, a weak signal; second-quarter sales fell 5.8% and operating profit 35.3%, and rate hikes make a housing rebound harder. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: Granite Ridge Resources 是「非作業型」油氣公司：不自己鑽井，而是買下各大盆地油井的工作權益，由別人作業、它按比例出錢分收入。為什麼被忽視：股價約 5 美元、非作業模式缺乏話題，油價破百的行情裡資金都去追大型頁岩油與油服。什麼正在改變：9 月內三位內部人接力買進，董事 McCartney 9/1 以 5.04 美元買 5,000 股、財務長 Kettler 9/4 以 5.05 美元買 6,000 股、董事 Matthew Miller 9/11 以 5.03 美元買 1 萬股（持股約 197 萬股）；第二季產量 32,044 桶油當量／日、淨利 3,000 萬美元，公司說 2026 是資本支出超過現金流的最後一年、年底產量目標 4 萬桶；季配息 0.11 美元，現價殖利率約 8.7%。風險與反方論點：若停火讓油價回落，高配息與擴產同時要錢；非作業者無法控制鑽井節奏；三筆買進合計約 10 萬美元，金額不大。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Granite Ridge Resources is a non-operated oil and gas company: it doesn't drill, but buys working interests in wells across major basins, paying and collecting its share while others operate. Why it's ignored: a roughly $5 stock with an unglamorous model, while oil above $100 sends money to big shale producers and service names. What's changing: three insiders bought in September, director McCartney 5,000 shares at $5.04 on Sept. 1, CFO Kettler 6,000 at $5.05 on Sept. 4 and director Matthew Miller 10,000 at $5.03 on Sept. 11 (holding about 1.97 million); second-quarter output was 32,044 Boe per day with $30.0 million net income, the company says 2026 is the last year capex exceeds cash flow, targeting 40,000 Boe per day at year-end; the $0.11 quarterly dividend yields about 8.7%. Risks and counterpoints: if a ceasefire drops oil, the dividend and growth both need cash; non-operators don't control drilling pace; the three purchases total only about $100,000. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: Angel Studios 是以付費會員「Guild」投票決定發行哪些電影的影視公司，主打價值觀與家庭題材。為什麼被忽視：題材被主流媒體視為小眾，上市時間短，追蹤分析師約 5 家，股價在 5 美元上下。什麼正在改變：董事 Steven Sarowitz 8/14 以 4.26 美元買約 5.8 萬股，9/9 以 4.95 美元買 13.3 萬股、9/10 再以 5.28 美元買 35.6 萬股，持股增加一倍多到約 124 萬股，InsiderClusters 統計一個月內三位內部人合計買進約 570 萬美元；第二季 Guild 付費會員 261 萬人、年增 99%，Guild 營收 9,070 萬美元、年增 94%，行銷費用占 Guild 營收從 71.6% 降到 52.8%，規模效益開始出現。風險與反方論點：第二季淨損仍擴大到 2,380 萬美元；會員成長靠下半年七部院線片撐，片子票房不如預期就會斷；小眾內容的天花板在哪裡還沒被證明。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Angel Studios is a film and TV company whose paying 'Guild' members vote on which titles it releases, focusing on values-driven and family content. Why it's ignored: mainstream media treat the niche as small, it's recently listed, about five analysts cover it and shares trade around $5. What's changing: director Steven Sarowitz bought about 58,000 shares at $4.26 on Aug. 14, 132,639 at $4.95 on Sept. 9 and 355,998 at $5.28 on Sept. 10, more than doubling his stake to about 1.24 million shares, and InsiderClusters counts about $5.7 million of buying by three insiders in a month; Guild paying members reached 2.61 million in the second quarter, up 99%, Guild revenue rose 94% to $90.7 million, and marketing fell to 52.8% of Guild revenue from 71.6%, showing scale benefits. Risks and counterpoints: the second-quarter net loss widened to $23.8 million; member growth leans on seven theatrical releases in the second half, which could disappoint; the ceiling for niche content is unproven. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: 池內的 Gloo Holdings（服務教會與非營利組織的 AI 平台）入池時設的驗證點是「第二季能否達成年增 172% 的指引」，結果超標：第二季營收 4,660 萬美元、年增 188%，全年營收指引上修到 2 億美元，第三季指引 5,500 萬美元、年增 69%，並預期第四季調整後 EBITDA 轉正。新動態是執行董事長、前英特爾執行長 Pat Gelsinger 9/11 以約 3.34 美元再買 5 萬股、約 16.7 萬美元，信託持股增加到 36.5 萬股。股價卻貼近 52 週低點 2.90 美元，距高點 9.98 美元跌了 67%，市場還在消化 7 月增發 700 萬股的稀釋。風險與反方論點：年增率從 188% 降到 69% 是明顯減速；獲利轉正還只是指引；增發可能不是最後一次。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Pool name Gloo Holdings, an AI platform for churches and nonprofits, entered with a checkpoint of hitting its 172% second-quarter growth guidance, and it beat: revenue rose 188% to $46.6 million, full-year guidance was raised to $200 million, third-quarter guidance is $55 million, up 69%, and it expects positive adjusted EBITDA in the fourth quarter. The new development: executive chair and former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger bought another 50,000 shares at about $3.34 on Sept. 11, roughly $167,000, lifting his trust's holding to 365,499 shares. Yet the stock sits near its 52-week low of $2.90, down 67% from a $9.98 high, as the market digests July's 7 million-share offering. Risks and counterpoints: growth slowing from 188% to 69% is a sharp deceleration; profitability is still only guidance; another offering is possible. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: 池內的 CarParts.com（線上汽車售後零件通路）9/12 入池時記錄的內部人買進約 43.8 萬美元，逐筆查 Form 4 後發現低估了。營運長 Michael Huffaker 在 9/4 到 9/9 之間買進 79,458 股、約 74.8 萬美元，持股增加到 13.9 萬股；執行長 David Meniane 則是分批進場，8/31 買 4,612 股、9/9 買 21,742 股、9/10 再以 10.06 美元買 13,250 股，持股 31.3 萬股。兩位經營者合計投入約百萬美元量級，以一家市值不到 2 億美元的公司來說分量不輕。基本面維持入池時的判斷：第二季營收年減 10.7%，但調整後 EBITDA 由負轉正 180 萬美元、連續第六季改善。風險與反方論點：營收仍在衰退，改善可能只是砍成本；亞馬遜等低價通路的競爭沒有變。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: When CarParts.com, an online auto parts retailer, entered the pool on Sept. 12, insider buying was recorded at about $438,000; a filing-by-filing check shows that understated it. COO Michael Huffaker bought 79,458 shares from Sept. 4 to Sept. 9, about $748,000, lifting his stake to 139,560 shares; CEO David Meniane bought in tranches, 4,612 shares on Aug. 31, 21,742 on Sept. 9 and 13,250 at $10.06 on Sept. 10, for 312,664 shares. The two executives committed on the order of $1 million, meaningful for a company worth under $200 million. Fundamentals are unchanged from entry: second-quarter sales fell 10.7%, but adjusted EBITDA turned positive at $1.8 million, a sixth straight quarter of improvement. Risks and counterpoints: revenue is still shrinking, improvement may be just cost cuts, and competition from Amazon and other low-price channels hasn't changed. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

tag: 池內更新 · 同業拿大單
zh: 池內的 United States Antimony（美國本土銻的開採與冶煉）9/12 被標註為「論點受損」：銻的實現售價從每磅 28.32 美元跌到 13.70 美元，毛利率崩到 7%。週一的新參考來自同業：同樣供應國防儲備的鎢製品商 Elmet Group，拿到國防後勤局上限 20 億美元的合約，外加戰爭部 4.5 億美元投資。這說明政府對關鍵礦物的做法，已經從「採購」升級到「出資蓋產能」，這正是 United States Antimony 垂直整合論點需要的政策環境；它手上那紙國防後勤局 2.45 億美元的五年獨家合約，截至第二季累計訂單 5,730 萬美元。風險與反方論點：同業拿到錢不等於它也會拿到；政策利多救不了銻價，入池時設的降級條件（Q3 實現售價續跌且自有礦石比重沒提升）仍然有效。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Pool name United States Antimony, a domestic antimony miner and smelter, was flagged 'thesis impaired' on Sept. 12 after its realized antimony price fell to $13.70 a pound from $28.32 and gross margin collapsed to 7%. Monday brought an outside reference from a peer: tungsten products maker Elmet Group, which also supplies the defense stockpile, won a Defense Logistics Agency contract worth up to $2 billion plus a $450 million Department of War investment. Government policy on critical minerals is moving from buying to funding capacity, the environment UAMY's vertical-integration thesis needs; its own five-year, $245 million sole-source DLA contract had $57.3 million of cumulative orders through the second quarter. Risks and counterpoints: a peer getting funded doesn't mean UAMY will; policy support can't fix antimony prices, and the downgrade trigger set earlier (falling realized prices in Q3 without a higher share of self-mined ore) still stands. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: Calvin Klein 與 Tommy Hilfiger 的母公司 PVH，執行長 Stefan Larsson 9/11 以平均 70.53 美元買進 14,179 股，金額約 100 萬美元。時間點有意思：股價前一週跌了將近 5%，而最近一季財報每股盈餘 3.70 美元、遠高於預估的 3.08 美元，但這個超標主要來自一次性的關稅退款，營收其實年減 3%。判讀提醒：執行長用自己的錢在財報後、股價回落時買進，是比較有分量的訊號；但也要看清楚，這份財報的「好」有一部分不會重複，他買進代表對品牌轉型有信心，不代表下一季還會有同樣的關稅退款。
en: PVH, parent of Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger, said CEO Stefan Larsson bought 14,179 shares at an average $70.53 on Sept. 11, about $1 million. The timing is notable: the stock fell nearly 5% the prior week, and the latest quarter's $3.70 EPS beat the $3.08 estimate, but mostly thanks to one-time tariff refunds while revenue fell 3%. Reading note: a CEO buying with his own money after earnings as the stock pulls back is a meaningful signal, but part of this report's strength won't repeat; his purchase shows confidence in the brand turnaround, not that next quarter will bring another tariff refund.

zh: GameStop 執行長 Ryan Cohen 9/10 以平均 20.38 美元買進 100 萬股、約 2,030 萬美元，董事 Alain Attal 同日買進 5,000 股、約 10 萬美元，消息出來後股價漲 4% 到 21.26 美元。在內部人篩選器上，這是當週金額最大的執行長買進之一。判讀提醒：金額要放在持股規模裡看。Cohen 買完後直接持有約 3,935 萬股，這次加碼只讓持股增加約 2.6%；對一位本來就重倉的大股東來說，這更像「維持信心的表態」，而不是發現新價值的突然押注。相比之下，一位持股很少的高管拿出年薪等級的錢買進，資訊量可能更大。
en: GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen bought 1 million shares at an average $20.38 on Sept. 10, about $20.3 million, and director Alain Attal bought 5,000 shares, about $100,000, the same day; shares rose 4% to $21.26 on the news. It was one of the largest CEO purchases on insider screens that week. Reading note: size must be judged against holdings. After the purchase Cohen directly owns about 39.35 million shares, so the buy raised his stake only about 2.6%; for an already heavily invested holder it reads more as a statement of continued confidence than a sudden bet on newly found value. An executive with a small stake spending a year's salary may carry more information.

zh: 本週內部人買進金額排行榜的第一名是廢棄物處理龍頭 Republic Services，單檔就占了數億美元，但買家不是經營團隊，而是蓋茲的投資公司 Cascade Investment。它是持股 36.7% 的大股東，8 月 18 日起幾乎每週都在買：8/18 至 8/19 約 37.9 萬股、8/24 至 8/25 約 57.1 萬股、8/27 約 56 萬股，9 月 3、4、9 日又在每股 220 到 225 美元間加碼。判讀提醒：Form 4 把持股超過 10% 的股東也算作「內部人」，所以這類長期配置資金常常把排行榜灌爆。它代表一位超長線投資人持續加碼，而不是管理層知道了什麼新消息；看篩選器時，最好把 10% 大股東與高管分開看。
en: The top name on this week's insider-buying leaderboard is waste hauler Republic Services, with hundreds of millions of dollars, but the buyer isn't management; it's Cascade Investment, Bill Gates's investment firm and a 36.7% holder. It has bought almost weekly since Aug. 18: about 379,000 shares Aug. 18-19, about 571,000 Aug. 24-25, about 560,000 Aug. 27, and more on Sept. 3, 4 and 9 at $220 to $225 a share. Reading note: Form 4 counts 10%-plus holders as insiders, so long-term allocators like this often dominate the rankings. It shows an ultra-long-term investor adding, not management acting on new information; when using screeners, separate 10% holders from executives.

zh: 參議員 John Boozman（共和黨、阿肯色州）9/14 申報的一份交易報告，結構比金額有看頭。買進的是 iShares 標普小型股 ETF 與 Avantis 美國小型價值股 ETF（8/19，各 1,001 至 1.5 萬美元），以及電梯大廠 Otis；賣出的是 Westwood 優質小型股主動型基金、嬌生，以及核電業者 Constellation Energy（8/13，1,001 至 1.5 萬美元）。這個部位結構代表的假設是：保留小型股與價值股的曝險，但從收費較高的主動型基金換成低成本 ETF，同時減碼估值已高的 AI 電力股。金額都在最低一級區間，屬於資產配置層級的調整，不是對單一公司的重押。
en: A transaction report filed Sept. 14 by Sen. John Boozman (R-Ark.) is more interesting for its structure than its size. He bought the iShares Core S&P Small-Cap ETF and the Avantis U.S. Small Cap Value ETF (Aug. 19, $1,001 to $15,000 each) plus elevator maker Otis, and sold the actively managed Westwood Quality SmallCap Fund, Johnson & Johnson and nuclear power producer Constellation Energy (Aug. 13, $1,001 to $15,000). The implied thesis: keep small-cap and value exposure but swap a higher-fee active fund for low-cost ETFs, while trimming a richly valued AI power stock. All amounts sit in the lowest range, an allocation-level adjustment rather than a concentrated bet on any company.

stocks.n: Avantis 小型價值股 ETF，申報中買進的低成本小型價值曝險
iShares 標普小型股 ETF，同份申報買進
Constellation Energy，8/13 賣出 1,001 至 1.5 萬美元

zh: 判讀提醒：申報日會製造「看起來很準」的錯覺。Boozman 賣出 Constellation Energy 是 8/13，但申報公開是 9/14，剛好撞上電力股因 AI 放慢論重挫的那一天；讀者很容易以為他預見了什麼，實際上交易與新聞隔了一個月，跟單者更不可能買到 8/13 的價位。另一個要看的是誰下的單：眾議員 Thomas Kean Jr. 同日申報賣出 Alphabet、微軟、嬌生，買進 Linde 與電網工程商 MasTec，但申報文件寫明賣出由第三方顧問執行、本人沒有參與，買進則在他持有 33% 的家族合夥事業裡。全權委託帳戶的交易，反映的是顧問的配置，不是議員的判斷。
en: A reading note: filing dates create an illusion of foresight. Boozman sold Constellation Energy on Aug. 13, but the filing became public Sept. 14, the very day power stocks slumped on the AI slowdown call; readers may think he saw something coming, yet the trade and the news were a month apart, and copycats could never get Aug. 13 prices. Also check who placed the order: Rep. Thomas Kean Jr. filed the same day showing sales of Alphabet, Microsoft and J&J and purchases of Linde and grid contractor MasTec, but the filing says the sales were made by third-party advisers without his input, and the purchases were in a family partnership in which he holds 33%. Trades in discretionary accounts reflect the adviser's allocation, not the lawmaker's judgment.

stocks.n: Constellation Energy，8/13 賣出、9/14 才公開，時間差造成的錯覺

zh: 今天最值得注意的一件事：同一篇「放慢 AI」的文章，市場讀出兩種完全相反的交易。賣的是晶片、電力設備與資料中心（GE Vernova 跌 8.62%），買的是資安（CrowdStrike、Zscaler 盤中漲約 15%）；可同一天 Anthropic 還簽下六年 137 億美元的算力合約。說的是放慢，手上簽的是加碼，真正的訂單要到下一季財報才看得出方向。再疊上 10 年期殖利率一度破 5%、週三升息幾成定局，估值高的長線題材同時被利率與政策兩頭擠壓。問題留給你：你手上押「AI 算力需求持續高速成長」的部位有哪些？如果這個假設從「確定」變成「有政策變數」，哪一檔最脆弱、哪一檔其實有長約撐著？
en: Today's most notable development: the same 'slow down AI' essay produced two opposite trades. Chips, power equipment and data centers were sold (GE Vernova fell 8.62%), while cybersecurity was bought (CrowdStrike and Zscaler up about 15% intraday), yet the same day Anthropic signed a six-year, $13.7 billion compute contract. The words say slow down, the signatures say more, and real order direction will only show in next quarter's reports. Add a 10-year yield that briefly topped 5% and a near-certain hike Wednesday, and richly valued long-duration themes are squeezed by both rates and policy. A question for you: which of your positions rely on AI compute demand continuing to grow rapidly? If that assumption shifts from certain to subject to policy, which is most fragile, and which is actually backed by long-term contracts?
